verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature. Indirect paths exist: the SDK can manage files inside a sandbox, external S3 storage can be mounted via FUSE so data stays in a user-owned store, and environments can be defined as standard OCI/Docker images, which keeps them portable. Missing for 10: a documented export of snapshots, drives, or persisted sandbox state in open formats; a bulk 'export all data' path; any offboarding or data-portability documentation; independent corroboration.
